# ceph_health (Data Source)

Reads the Ceph cluster's overall health status.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ceph_health" "this" {}

output "ceph_health_status" {
  value = data.ceph_health.this.health_status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `health_status` (String) Overall cluster health status: `HEALTH_OK`, `HEALTH_WARN`, or `HEALTH_ERR`.
